points.en: ICAO is a specialized agency of the United Nations.
points.hi: ICAO is a specialized agency of the United Nations.

points.en: Established by the Convention on International Civil Aviation (Chicago Convention) in 1944.
points.hi: Established by the Convention on International Civil Aviation (Chicago Convention) in 1944.

points.en: Objective: To foster the planning and development of international air transport.
points.hi: Objective: To foster the planning and development of international air transport.

points.en: Sets international standards and recommended practices (SARPs) for aviation safety, security, and efficiency.
points.hi: Sets international standards and recommended practices (SARPs) for aviation safety, security, and efficiency.

points.en: Facilitates the development of air navigation infrastructure.
points.hi: Facilitates the development of air navigation infrastructure.

points.en: Ensures the orderly growth of international civil aviation worldwide.
points.hi: Ensures the orderly growth of international civil aviation worldwide.

misconception.en: ICAO is a regulatory body with enforcement powers over national airlines.
misconception.hi: ICAO is a regulatory body with enforcement powers over national airlines.

correction.en: ICAO sets standards (SARPs) that member states are expected to implement; it does not have direct enforcement authority over private airlines.
correction.hi: ICAO sets standards (SARPs) that member states are expected to implement; it does not have direct enforcement authority over private airlines.

fiveFacts.en: ICAO is a UN specialized agency.
fiveFacts.hi: ICAO is a UN specialized agency.

fiveFacts.en: Established in 1944 via the Chicago Convention.
fiveFacts.hi: Established in 1944 via the Chicago Convention.

fiveFacts.en: Focuses on safety, security, and environmental sustainability.
fiveFacts.hi: Focuses on safety, security, and environmental sustainability.

threeTraps.en: Confusing ICAO with IATA (IATA is a trade association, not a UN agency).
threeTraps.hi: Confusing ICAO with IATA (IATA is a trade association, not a UN agency).

threeTraps.en: Assuming ICAO has direct legal jurisdiction over domestic flights.
